# KMEP

> KMEP is a YouTube extraction library written in pure Dart — a stable,
> production-tested alternative to NewPipeExtractor for Flutter and
> Dart applications. It extracts videos (up to 4K), streams, search,
> shorts, channels, playlists and comments directly on-device via
> YouTube's InnerTube API, with no JVM, no Python runtime, and no
> backend server.

KMEP runs the full extraction pipeline in-process: multi-client
InnerTube fallback (ANDROID_VR → WEB → IOS → WEB_SAFARI → TV), real
`player.js` execution for signature/`n`-parameter reversal, and
on-device BotGuard PO token generation. It has been the default
extraction engine of the Vidora Android app in production for over a
month, holding a 98% (49/50) live-audited success rate.

## Key features

- Video metadata + resolved stream URLs — all formats YouTube serves, up to 4K, live/HLS
- Multi-client InnerTube fallback: ANDROID_VR → WEB → IOS → WEB_SAFARI → TV, runtime-tunable via RemoteConfig
- On-device signature/`n` resolution via real `player.js` execution (WebView or Node.js runtime)
- On-device PO token generation (BotGuard) — no bgutil server, no external services
- Search (typed results, paginated) and shorts-only feed
- Channels: header, tabs, videos with pagination, shorts/live tabs
- Playlists: header + full video pagination
- Comments: top/newest sorting, pages, thread replies, pinned/hearted/verified
- Pure Dart core with typed API — `Kmep` facade class
- GPL-3.0-or-later, pre-1.0 (v0.3.0)

## Install

Published on pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/kmep

```yaml
dependencies:
  kmep: ^0.3.0
```

```dart
import 'package:kmep/kmep.dart';

final kmep = Kmep.withOnDevicePoToken(
  jsRuntime: myPlayerJsRuntime,    // WebViewJsRuntime on Flutter
  potJsRuntime: myBotGuardRuntime, // a separate JS context
  fetchText: (url) => http.get(Uri.parse(url)).then((r) => r.body),
);

final video = await kmep.getVideo('dQw4w9WgXcQ');
```

## KMEP vs NewPipeExtractor

| | KMEP | NewPipeExtractor |
|---|---|---|
| Language / runtime | Pure Dart | Java/Kotlin (JVM) |
| Integration | Native Flutter/Dart app dependency | Requires JVM or platform bridges |
| PO tokens | On-device BotGuard, built-in | External tooling / not built-in |
| Client fallback | 5 InnerTube clients, runtime-tunable | Multi-client (YouTube only) |
| Remote config (fix without release) | Yes, RemoteConfig + circuit breaker | No |
| Typed API surface | Yes (Kmep facade) | StreamInfo objects, JVM-centric |
| License | GPL-3.0-or-later | GPL-3.0 |
